name: fastapi-website-blueprint-tools
description: Locked versions of the npm-based lint/format tools (no build step, no runtime deps). Exact versions are pinned in package-lock.json, kept current by Dependabot. Install with `npm ci`; the devcontainer images bake them in. TEMPORARY: overrides.js-yaml forces the patched 5.2.2 over the vulnerable 5.2.1 that markdownlint-cli2 requires (`npm audit` or git auditor flags it) - remove the override as soon as a markdownlint-cli2 release requires >=5.2.2 itself; npm stays silent when an override becomes a no-op, so re-check on every markdownlint-cli2 bump.
